doc: souji r73 C2 defang set (frozen at the r73 freeze). Each member is ONE exact single-occurrence string edit of a counter source; applied to census/round-72/c1-counter.py for the before-controls and to census/round-73/c1-counter.py for the after-arms (apply-edit.py asserts count == 1 in both). Each edit keeps the row's driver/attribute set-up and removes the row's byte forgery, so the reference-weak base writer still accepts the row while no worktree byte, mode or path differs from the row's revision before or after the run (pre-freeze probe probes/witness-defang-*.txt). A counter that credits such a row as a base forgery without observing a divergence miscounts it.
